items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Steve and Eydie recorded, they’re all gone.

ctx.x: So you’d travel from one date to another in a particular day.

Oh yeah we were running man. See and what was great in those days in the 70s in New York was all the studios, most of them were close. You could walk to them. You could walk from one studio to another, or hop in a cab for just five minutes and you’d be at the next studio. You know. Everything was close. Everything was all centered in midtown you know. And then that all ended man. You know there’s no studios left in New York man, I’m telling you, there’s a couple of rehearsal studios. There are no recording…
were not that good in the old days. Now, man, the bands on Broadway are terrific because these guys are out of work, the good players.
